item.title: Rooted Libraries Project
item.description:
30-250 CAD | Can you turn social media followers into people who donate, share, and stay with a cause? We're looking for a nonprofit-savvy social media and brand manager to help a young organization build trust from day one.
**ABOUT US** The AVID Foundation is a Canadian non-profit that refurbishes and sustains libraries in under-resourced Nigerian schools, starting in Lagos. Every library project covers five things: renovating the space, locally built furniture, books weighted toward Nigerian and African authors and aligned with the national curriculum, a simple cataloguing system, and training for school staff.
We're at an early stage. Our first cohort of schools is about to begin, and our Instagram and LinkedIn accounts are just getting started.
Website: www.theavidfoundation.org
**WHAT YOU'LL DO** • **Content creation:** Design graphics, carousels and short videos, with captions that fit our established brand (logo, colours, voice). Build reusable templates so everything we post looks consistent. • **Impact storytelling:** Turn field updates from Lagos into clear visual stories that show progress and accountability. These include before-and-after photos, furniture builds, book deliveries, teacher training, and students using their new library. • **Audience and hashtag research:** Find the hashtags, communities and accounts that reach our audiences. These are individual donors in Canada, the Nigerian diaspora, educators, literacy and book communities, and institutional and grant funders on LinkedIn. • **Platform management:** Plan a monthly content calendar. Schedule posts on Instagram and LinkedIn (our priorities), plus Facebook and Threads. • **Fundraising engagement:** Plan and run social campaigns around giving moments such as GivingTuesday, International Literacy Day and our school launches. Each campaign needs clear calls to action that move followers to our website and donation page. • **Community management:** Respond to comments and messages, and engage with partner and peer organizations. • **Brand stewardship:** Keep everything we publish on-brand, and help shape our short-, medium- and long-term social media strategy. • **Reporting:** Send a short monthly report covering what we posted, what worked, and how followers are turning into website visits, sign-ups and donations.
**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** • A portfolio of social media work for nonprofits, NGOs or charities • Strong design skills in Canva, and excellent written English • Experience with ethical, dignity-first storytelling. Our work involves children, so you'll follow consent and safeguarding practices. That means no identifying details without permission and no pity-driven imagery. • Familiarity with both Nigerian and Canadian audiences (a strong asset)
**SCOPE** • 2-3 posts per week across Instagram and LinkedIn, plus campaign content as needed • Ongoing monthly engagement, starting with a paid one-month trial • Fully remote
**HOW TO APPLY** Start your proposal with the words "Turning Page" so we know you've read this. Then share: 1. 2–3 nonprofit social media projects you've worked on, and what they achieved 2. How you would turn a single photo of a newly renovated school library into a post that builds donor trust 3. Your proposed monthly rate and what it includes

item.title: Expert Website Developer Needed to Recreate and Improve 6 Premium Websites
item.description:
250-251 USD | Senior / Expert • Fixed-price or milestone-based • Long-term collaboration potential
Project scope: Rebuild and enhance six existing websites Primary objective: Same or better design quality and functionality
Project Overview We are seeking a highly skilled website developer or professional development team to recreate six of our existing company websites. Our websites already have established designs, branding, content, and visual presentations.
Our primary requirement is to reproduce these websites with the same or better design quality, appearance, and functionality. We do not want basic templates, simplified designs, or lower-quality replacements.
Existing Website Examples 1. https://concord-pacific-investments.vercel.app/ 2. https://master-craft-international.vercel.app/ 3. https://concordpacificcorp.com/ 4. https://sprinter-3364.vercel.app/ 5. https://sprinterone.us/ 6. Additional website to be provided. Please examine these websites carefully before submitting your proposal.
Development Requirements 1. Accurate website reproduction. Recreate layouts, graphics, typography, colors, visual presentation, navigation, and applicable functionality. Deliver design quality equal to or better than the originals. 2. Professional improvements. Recommend enhancements to design, loading speed, navigation, responsiveness, and user experience without diminishing the current professional appearance. 3. Advanced front-end development. Demonstrate experience with responsive design, custom interfaces, animation, and interactive elements. React, Next.js, Vercel, or comparable technologies are preferred. 4. Functionality. Reproduce all agreed existing functions, including navigation, forms, and relevant interactive components. Any new backend systems or application functionality will be scoped separately. 5. Complete ownership. Transfer all completed source code, design assets, administrative access, and deployment configurations. We require full control of the websites without ongoing developer dependency.
Developer Qualifications & Proposal Details We are seeking proven expertise, attention to detail, and reliable project delivery.
Who We Want to Hire • Experience producing premium corporate websites. • Ability to accurately reproduce sophisticated existing designs. • Excellent visual design and front-end development skills. • Capability with responsive interfaces, animations, and interactive features. • Independent technical problem-solving and clear communication. • Ability to meet agreed timelines and interest in long-term collaboration.
Initial Paid Test Project We prefer to begin with one website as an initial paid project. The developer must demonstrate the ability to reproduce the existing level of quality before we proceed with the remaining five websites.
Our objective is to establish a reliable, long-term relationship with a talented developer or development team.
What to Include in Your Proposal 1. Links to your three best completed websites. 2. Examples of sophisticated websites you personally developed. 3. Your recommended technology stack. 4. Your estimated budget for reproducing all six websites. 5. Your estimated completion timeline. 6. Confirmation that you can match or exceed the existing quality. 7. Details of your experience with animation, responsive design, and custom functionality.
Our budget is $250 USD per website.
PLEASE DO NOT SUBMIT GENERIC PROPOSALS. We want developers who have reviewed the websites and understand the quality expected. Quality, reliability, technical expertise, and attention to detail are our highest priorities.

item.title: Sabre API Flight Hotel Engine
item.description:
150-300 USD | I need a lightweight OTA front-end built around the Sabre API that lets users search flights and hotels on the same website, see live availability, and then hand the booking off to me for manual ticketing.
Core flow • Home page with a combined flight & hotel search panel. • Flight search must offer three date modes: exact date, ±1 day, or ±3 days. • After a traveller chooses an itinerary or property and submits their details, the system should: – Create a Sabre PNR in my PCC. – Store the quoted fare in the PNR. – Fire an email (or webhook) notification to me containing the booking summary so I can verify everything and issue the ticket offline. No online payment gateway is required at this stage.
Please use Sabre’s latest REST/JSON services where possible; fallback to SOAP calls if a feature is missing. A clean, responsive UI (plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript or a light framework like React) is fine as long as the code is easy for me to maintain.
Deliverables 1. Source code for the search and booking modules. 2. Simple front page template wired to the search logic. 3. Documentation: setup, environment variables, and Sabre credentials required. 4. Brief hand-off call or video explaining deployment and PNR flow.
If you have previous Sabre or other GDS experience, let me know—speed of delivery and API accuracy are key for me.

item.title: Website Site Refresh
item.description:
20-250 GBP | **Premium Pizza Website Redesign
I’m looking for a talented website designer and WordPress developer to redesign **www.jianis.co.uk** into a premium, engaging website that builds credibility, attracts customers and generates event catering enquiries.
**About Jiani’s**
Jiani’s is a founder-led, Napoli-inspired pizza business offering handcrafted pizzas, freshly cooked on-site for private parties, weddings, corporate functions, schools, festivals and community events.
We also run a weekly Friday pop-up at Stanmore Place in London.
Our brand values are **Pizza • Love • Unity • Joy**, and our promise is **“Delivering happiness in every box.”**
The website should showcase the quality of our pizza, the experience of live pizza-making and the people and community behind the brand.
**Creative direction**
I want a distinctive website with a premium but approachable feel: warm, confident, contemporary and visually memorable.
Strong food photography, elegant typography, thoughtful colours, generous spacing and professional graphic design are essential. The website should feel like a credible, growing food brand with its own personality.
I’m looking for someone who can interpret the brand and contribute creative ideas, rather than simply populate a standard template.
**Animation and graphics**
I would like tasteful animated text and graphics, including ideas such as:
- Animated headlines and text reveals. - Smooth transitions and scroll-triggered effects. - Subtle movement in photographs and branded graphics. - Creative button and hover effects. - Small visual details inspired by pizza-making and our brand.
The animation should feel polished, playful and premium. It must work well on mobile, preserve loading speed and support reduced-motion preferences.
**Landing-page video**
I plan to commission a professional brand video. The homepage should use strong photography initially and be designed so the video can be added later without rebuilding the layout.
**Pages required**
- **Home:** A strong visual introduction, clear positioning, brand highlights and prominent calls to action. - **Menu:** An attractive, easy-to-update presentation of pizzas, desserts and dietary information. - **Events and Catering:** Our offering, event types, photography, FAQs and enquiry buttons. - **Our Story:** The founder’s journey, our craft and what Jiani’s stands for. - **Community and Stanmore Pop-Up:** Our community story, Friday opening times, location and directions. - **Contact / Book an Event:** Business contact details and a straightforward enquiry form.
The main objective is to generate event enquiries. The secondary objective is to encourage visits to our weekly pop-up.
**Functionality and technical requirements**
- WordPress website hosted on my existing Hostinger account. - Responsive layouts for mobile, tablet and desktop. - Easy editing of copy, menus, images and opening times. - Event enquiry form capturing name, email, phone, event date, location, event type, estimated guest count and message. - Reliable email delivery for enquiries, spam protection and a clear submission confirmation. - Click-to-call, email, social media and map/directions links. - Fast-loading, optimised images and video handling. - Accessible navigation, readable text and appropriate colour contrast. - Basic on-page SEO, page titles, meta descriptions, sitemap and relevant local business information. - SSL, backups and appropriate WordPress security configuration. - Privacy and cookie requirements addressed according to the features used. - No online ordering or payment system required at this stage.
**Wix migration and launch**
Please include migration of relevant existing content and the move from Wix to WordPress, including:
- Preserving the existing domain and business email. - Mapping existing URLs and implementing redirects where needed. - Building on a staging site while the current website remains available. - Testing forms, links, layouts and performance before launch. - Managing the final domain connection with minimal disruption.
Please explain your recommended WordPress theme, editor or page builder, including any paid plugins, licences and renewal costs.
**Materials I can provide**
- Detailed brand book with positioning, founder story, community story, draft website copy and creative direction. - Vector logo files. - Existing food and brand photography. - Additional branding references. - An initial website concept for reference.
The copy can be refined for clarity and layout while preserving the brand’s personality and key messages.
**Mock-up and examples**
Please share relevant websites you have personally designed, particularly food, hospitality or premium brands. Include examples featuring animated typography and graphics.
I would like an initial homepage mock-up showing your proposed layout, typography, colours, imagery and overall creative direction. Please also explain the proposed animations or provide a short motion preview.
**Deliverables**
- Approved website design and completed WordPress development. - Migration and launch on Hostinger. - Tested enquiry forms and responsive layouts. - Editable design assets and full administrator access. - A short guide or recorded walkthrough showing how to update the website. - An agreed period of post-launch support for fixing defects. - Full ownership of the completed website and project assets.
**Please include in your proposal**
- Relevant portfolio examples and your role in each project. - Your creative approach for Jiani’s. - Recommended WordPress setup. - Fixed project price and milestone breakdown. - Estimated timeline and number of design revisions. - All additional or recurring costs. - What you need from me to begin. - Details of post-launch support.

item.title: WordPress Redesign with 3D Tours

• A new logo for the foundation • A responsive, WCAG-friendly front-end that loads quickly and is easy for non-technical staff to edit • A custom post type or similar method for adding each building once, then displaying it in listings, on a map, and on its own detail page with the 3-D embed. • Smooth integration of optional extras (you can stage or comment the code so I can switch them on when ready): – Newsletter sign-up with double opt-in (Mailchimp or comparable). – Members-only area for additional content and information – Hook or plugin suggestion for an AI assistant that can draft content from internet sources. • Basic performance, security and backup settings in place. • Clear hand-over notes or a brief video that shows me how to add new buildings and swap in future full tours.
If you have previous work that shows you can balance refined aesthetics with technical polish, please include it. I am ready to start within a few days and aim to go live inside four weeks.

item.title: Complete Website Audit with Detailed Issues, Solutions & Implementation Guidelines
item.description:
50-100 USD | ## Project Description
I am looking for an experienced website auditor or technical SEO specialist to conduct a **comprehensive audit of my website** and provide a detailed report covering all major issues, their root causes, and practical, step-by-step solutions.
My goal is not simply to receive a list of errors generated by automated tools. I need a professional, in-depth analysis of my website, with clear explanations of every significant issue discovered and specific instructions on how to resolve each one.
The audit should help me understand what is wrong with my website, why each issue matters, how it affects website performance or SEO, and exactly what needs to be done to fix it.
## Scope of Work
### 1. Technical SEO Audit - Identify crawling and indexing issues. - Review robots.txt, XML sitemap, canonical tags, and meta robots directives. - Identify broken links, redirect chains, redirect loops, and 404 errors. - Check URL structure and website architecture. - Audit duplicate content, orphan pages, and crawlability issues. - Review structured data and schema markup. - Identify Core Web Vitals and other technical SEO problems.
### 2. On-Page SEO Audit - Analyze title tags and meta descriptions. - Review heading structure (H1, H2, H3, etc.). - Identify missing, duplicated, or poorly optimized metadata. - Evaluate keyword targeting and search intent alignment. - Review internal linking and anchor text. - Analyze image optimization, alt text, and image file sizes. - Identify thin, duplicate, outdated, or poorly structured content. - Review canonicalization and other on-page SEO best practices.
### 3. Website Speed and Performance Audit - Test website performance on desktop and mobile. - Analyze loading speed and Core Web Vitals. - Identify oversized images, unnecessary scripts, and render-blocking resources. - Review CSS and JavaScript optimization opportunities. - Check caching, compression, and resource-loading strategies. - Identify server response time or other performance bottlenecks where measurable.
### 4. Mobile Responsiveness and User Experience (UX) - Identify layout problems on different screen sizes. - Check navigation, menus, buttons, forms, and interactive elements. - Identify usability issues that may confuse or frustrate visitors. - Review readability, accessibility, and visual consistency. - Highlight friction points in important user journeys and conversion paths.
### 5. Website Security and Best Practices - Check HTTPS implementation and mixed-content issues. - Review security headers and other externally observable security configurations where applicable. - Identify exposed information or obvious security misconfigurations within the agreed scope. - Review outdated software or components where reliable evidence is available. - Provide recommendations for improving website security.
Security testing must remain within the authorized scope and should not involve destructive testing or unauthorized access.
### 6. Content and Website Structure Audit - Review the quality, organization, and relevance of website content. - Identify content gaps, cannibalization, duplication, and weak internal linking. - Evaluate navigation structure and important page accessibility. - Identify opportunities to improve content organization and topical relevance.
### 7. Accessibility and Technical Best Practices - Identify common accessibility issues, including missing labels, insufficient color contrast, image alternatives, and keyboard-navigation problems. - Review HTML structure, semantic elements, and other relevant implementation practices. - Recommend improvements aligned with recognized accessibility standards, where applicable.
### 8. Analytics and Conversion Tracking Review - Review Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console configuration if access is provided. - Identify obvious tracking gaps, duplicate tracking, or improperly configured events. - Review conversion tracking for relevant forms, buttons, leads, or purchases. - Provide recommendations for improving measurement and reporting.
## Most Important Requirement: Detailed Solutions for Every Issue
**Finding an issue is not enough. Every reported issue must include a clear, practical, and detailed solution.**
For each issue identified, I expect the report to include:
1. **Issue Title:** A clear name for the problem. 2. **Affected URL(s):** The exact pages or resources where the issue occurs. 3. **Evidence:** Screenshots, tool results, code examples, test results, or other supporting evidence. 4. **Explanation:** What the issue is and why it matters. 5. **Root Cause:** The likely reason behind the issue, supported by evidence where possible. 6. **Impact:** How it may affect SEO, website speed, user experience, accessibility, security, or conversions. 7. **Priority Level:** Critical, High, Medium, or Low, based on severity and business impact. 8. **Detailed Solution:** The recommended fix, explained in straightforward language. 9. **Step-by-Step Implementation Guide:** Exactly what to do, where to do it, and how to do it. 10. **Code Examples or Settings:** Where applicable, provide corrected code snippets, configuration examples, recommended settings, or before-and-after examples. 11. **Required Tools or Access:** Specify any CMS access, developer assistance, plugins, or tools needed. 12. **Verification Method:** Explain how to confirm that the issue has been fixed and which tools or tests to use.
For example, if a page has a missing canonical tag, I do not want the report to simply say "Add a canonical tag." I expect the freelancer to identify the affected page, explain why the tag is needed, provide the appropriate canonical URL, show an example of the correct implementation, explain where to add it in my CMS or website code, and describe how to verify the fix.
The same level of detail should be provided for every significant issue found.
## Expected Deliverables
- A complete website audit report in PDF, Google Docs, or another mutually agreed format. - A prioritized list of all identified issues, organized by category. - A detailed, issue-by-issue solution and implementation guide. - Relevant screenshots, evidence, and affected URLs. - Code snippets, configuration examples, or before-and-after examples wherever useful. - A prioritized action plan showing what should be fixed first, next, and later. - A summary of quick wins, major problems, and long-term improvement opportunities. - A final checklist that I can use to track implementation and verify completed fixes.
A spreadsheet containing the issues, affected URLs, priorities, recommended fixes, and verification status would also be appreciated.
## Quality Expectations
- The audit must be specific to my website, not a generic template. - Automated tools may be used, but their findings must be manually reviewed and interpreted. - Recommendations must be practical, technically accurate, and tailored to my website's platform and configuration. - Clearly distinguish confirmed issues from potential problems that require further investigation. - Avoid vague recommendations such as "improve SEO," "optimize speed," or "fix technical errors" without explaining the actual steps required. - Do not recommend unnecessary changes or guarantee rankings, traffic, or business results. - Clearly identify any limitations caused by missing access or unavailable data.
## Please Include in Your Proposal
When applying for this project, please explain:
1. Your experience conducting comprehensive website audits. 2. The tools you intend to use, such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, PageSpeed Insights, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, or other relevant tools. 3. How you will investigate issues and validate your findings rather than relying solely on automated reports. 4. How you will document detailed, step-by-step solutions for each issue. 5. An example of a previous audit report or a sample issue with its recommended solution, if available. 6. Your estimated delivery time and fixed project price. 7. Whether you can also implement the fixes or provide recommendations only.
## Final Objective
I want a thorough, professional, and actionable website audit that gives me a clear understanding of my website's current condition and a practical roadmap for resolving the identified issues.
**The key requirement is simple: every significant issue must be accompanied by a detailed explanation of what to do, how to do it, where to implement the fix, and how to verify that it has been resolved.**
Please review the complete scope before submitting your proposal. I value the quality, accuracy, depth, and practical usefulness of the audit more than a short report containing a large number of unexplained errors.

item.title: Booking-Style Hotel Site MVP
item.description:
250-750 EUR | I need an MVP that lets travellers search for hotels, see real-time availability, and secure a room in just a few clicks. For this first release the scope is intentionally narrow: hotels only—no apartments, hostels, or holiday homes—and the only module I care about right now is search-and-booking.
Core flow • Guests enter destination, dates, and guest count. • Results show available hotels with photos, amenities, room types, and up-to-date pricing. • On the hotel page they choose a room, then either pay online in full (Stripe, PayPal, or a similar gateway) or select “pay at the hotel.” • A confirmation email with a reservation code is sent automatically in both cases.
What’s out of scope for this phase: an owner extranet, loyalty programmes, reviews, or other post-stay features. Build the architecture with future modules in mind, but keep the current deliverable lean.
Deliverables (hand-off ready) • Responsive web application (frontend, backend, database schema) running on a test server plus all source code in Git. • Clear setup instructions and brief technical documentation.
Acceptance criteria • Search, booking, and the dual-payment option work end-to-end without errors. • Confirmation emails arrive within one minute. • Code is clean, readable, and modular for future expansion.
